==Usage==
Copy-paste the following code and replace "page," "URL," and "date" with the appropriate page link, its full URL, and its index date on [[Wikipedia:Google|Google]]. The use of "page" is optional.

<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>GoogleIndex|page=''page''|url=''URL''|date=''date''|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</code>

==Examples==
<code><nowiki>{{GoogleIndex|page={{Databank|cassian-andor|Cassian Andor}}|url=www.starwars.com/databank/cassian-andor|date=2016-08-10|archivedate=20240117033153}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:
{{GoogleIndex|page={{Databank|cassian-andor|Cassian Andor}}|url=www.starwars.com/databank/cassian-andor|date=2016-08-10|archivedate=20240117033153}}

<hr />

<code><nowiki>{{GoogleIndex|url=www.starwars.com/databank/cassian-andor|date=2016-08-10|archivedate=20240117033153}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:
